player_prompt.intro:
Yaa {role} mɛn Colonel Blotto.
Kɛlɛm kiɛm wɛɛndɛ winɛ pɛɛndɛ kɛlɛm kiɛm lafiɛɛ.
Kɛlɛm kiɛm pɛɛndɛ, kɛlɛm {num_total_units} unitɛɛ kɛlɛm {field_names}.
Nɛɛndɛ kiɛm wɛɛndɛ kɛlɛm unitɛɛ kɛlɛm fieldɛɛ, ɛɛndɛ kiɛm wɛɛndɛ kɛlɛm fieldɛɛ wɛɛndɛ roundɛɛ.
Kɛlɛm kiɛm '[A7 B7 C6]' kɛlɛm 7 unitɛɛ A, 7 B, ɛɛndɛ 6 C.
